oliver: Heads up — I'm swapping Thu night oncall with @jess. Leaving some routing tweaks below, please ack if you see anything odd overnight.

jess: Ack, I'll take Thu. Quick Q: did you reroute batch alerts to #eng-oncall or #eng-sre? I remember a PR.

oliver: Rerouted p1 -> #eng-sre, kept p2 -> #eng-oncall. Also bumped the batch-gpu noisy alert threshold from 5 -> 10/hour to cut duplicate pages. Snippet:
```
alert_name: batch-gpu-queue-noise
threshold_per_hour: 10
route: #eng-sre
```

kevin: FYI I nudged the cpu-spike suppress window 3m -> 10m yesterday to reduce flapping. Monitor for missed steady-state signals :eyes: 

oncall-bot: routing rule applied (id=4832) by kevin at 1838900000 — run: /sanity-check

maria: Left a quick synthetic run that should trigger p2 if latency > 400ms. Results in dashboards in ~5m.

jess: Got it. I'll watch the APM + alert log and ping if anything spikes. If we miss a p1, escalate to paging-policy-ops and tag @sre-lead :thumbsup:
